d:
Sajde is a song which shows the internal fight of a man with his emotions. He has loved beyond capacity and emptied himself. This has landed him into a dark space where he feels guilty. Despite this feeling of guilt and regret, he still ends up giving in to the feeling of love and he has no control over it. The song speaks of passion and how losing everything means nothing and losing one’s beloved means that everything is lost.
Lyrics -
Sajde kiye hotey khuda ke maine agar
Chord ke na jaata woh bhi iss qadar
Sajda kiya
Sajda kiya tera hi maine magar
Iss liye gaya mujhe chord kar
Zaaya sapne
